description: The encrypted-ip module (opt-in build) with a Google key file holding two keys: a key file must hold exactly one, the active one, as Google's does (recipients rotate by keeping old private keys, not by listing several public keys), so the module never guesses which to use. It's an error, with no eip field for any recipient, and the rest of the payload is unchanged. SID_MODULE_TIMEOUT_MS is 1000, as in the other encrypted-ip files.

cases.name: reports an error, with no eip field, for a key file with two keys
